  • Alsea↗Continuing constituent community government association
    Connection & source
    Continuing constituent community government association

    Actual Siletz tribal heritage introduction names Alsea, Coos and Galice/Applegate among distinct constituent peoples; government address is Siletz, Oregon. This is a diaspora/government connection, not all ancestral lands.

    Historical and continuing; geography passage inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Historical and continuing homeland connection

  • Klamath↗Historical homeland and confederated community
    Connection & source
    Historical homeland and confederated community

    The Klamath Tribes identify Klamath among their constituent peoples and explicitly locate their longstanding homeland in Oregon's Klamath Basin. Only a state connection is indexed.

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
